about: How a hint names a webagents command, the same in both CLIs (2026-09-25): with --profile while a profile is active, quoted as shlex.quote quotes a name that is not one shell word. Python: tests/cli/test_cli_command.py, TypeScript: tests/unit/cli/cli-command.test.ts.

hints.sign_in: Use a provider key: webagents --profile local secrets set OPENAI_API_KEY.
hints.credits: Add credits in Robutler, or use a provider key of your own (webagents --profile local secrets set OPENAI_API_KEY).
